title: Coherent contravariant exactness of native derived internal Hom
statement: Let C be a monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with a braided, additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. In its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] use the native closed structure for the tensor induced by quasi-isomorphism localization. For every W the native internal-Hom functor [-,W]:D(C)^op → D(C) admits coherent commutation with all integral shifts and is triangulated for that structure. The source uses the opposite triangulated shift, which reverses the integer. No evaluation, biduality map or geometric object is part of this assertion.

proof.text: The source library already constructs the native monoidal closed structure for derived tensor over C using its K-flat left derivability structure. Fix its internal-Hom bifunctor, and an arbitrary target W. The desired assertion concerns its contravariant source variable, not the already constructed ordinary right adjoint in the target variable.

Choose a K-injective representative I of W. The source-library map qhInternalHomToIhom P I, adjoint to evaluation, is an isomorphism and is natural in P. Hence the functor P ↦ Q internalHomObj P I sends quasi-isomorphisms to isomorphisms and represents native Hom(-,W) after localization. The underlying complex in degree n is the product of [P^p,I^q] for p+n=q, with differential (-1)^p(d_I f-f d_P).

The private, fully proved cochainSourceShift gives source-shift isomorphisms categorically by right-adjoint uniqueness and the two-variable tensor shift. To normalize the model maps, for m in Z put q(m)=m(m-1)/2. On the target factor indexed by r, reindexing gives F(P[m]) -> F(P)[-m] with coefficient (-1)^(m*r+q(m)). The Hom differential (-1)^p(d_I f-f d_P), d_(P[m])=(-1)^m d_P and the change of the coefficient under r -> r+1 verify the chain-map equation. Inverse reindexing gives an inverse. Precomposition gives naturality. Raw reindexings compose with discrepancy (-1)^(m*l), canceled by q(m+l)=q(m)+q(l)+m*l, proved for all integers by the private sourceShiftSign_add. At zero the map is the identity. Setting m=-n gives the coherent opposite n-shift, including negative n.

For a degreewise split sequence A -> B -> C with retraction r and section s, the source connecting cochain is h_p = r_(p+1) ∘ d_B ∘ s_p. The reversed Hom sequence has retraction pre(s) and section pre(r), as provided by internalHomShortComplexSplitting. Its connecting cochain, at degree n and the factor C^p -> I^(p+n+1), is (-1)^(p+1) f_(p+1) h_p: expand section*d_F*retraction; the d_I term vanishes since r_p ∘ s_p=0, and the remaining term has this sign. Mathlib triangleOpEquivalence sends the third arrow to h[-1].op without an additional sign. Applying F and the m=-1 comparison gives exactly this same factor, since q(-1)=1. Thus the image is the actual distinguished triangle of the reversed Hom split sequence, including its connecting morphism.

Localize the coherent shift comparisons along the opposite of Q. All quasi-isomorphisms are inverted by the model comparison in step 2. Every distinguished triangle is isomorphic to the image of a degreewise split sequence of complexes, so step 4 proves IsTriangulated for the localized functor with the shift structure from step 3. Descend the natural model isomorphism qhInternalHomToIhom, and transport shifts and the triangle property across it. Finally transport along the chosen isomorphism Q I = W. The assertion uses no boundedness or reflexivity, and the displayed integral sign identities apply also in characteristic two.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight generic hits on opposite triangulated functors, adjunctions and Hom functors; none constructs native contravariant derived Hom exactness.
Twelve hits: the class, identity, composition, additive consequences and transport across a natural isomorphism. No contravariant internal-Hom construction.

No matching native contravariant derived-Hom exactness theorem. Local source ClosedTriangulated gives an unspecified third arrow only. The recorded ringedInternalHom_exact concerns SheafOfModules and has no native ModuleCat-valued-sheaf comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: In the unbounded derived category of a monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian category, internal Hom into a fixed object is a triangulated functor from the opposite derived category, coherently commuting with all integer shifts.
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: MonoidalClosed.internalHom, Cartesian.internalHom, Functor.isTriangulated_of_op, Functor.IsTriangulated, exact-functor derived CommShift, ihom, MonoidalClosed.closed, and mapHomotopyCategory triangulatedness. These give the underlying closed functor and generic exactness tools, not the source-variable exactness of native derived Hom.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeInternalHom_contravariant_exact
    (C : Type c) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} C] [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalPreadditive C]
    [BraidedCategory C] [MonoidalClosed C] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    (W : DerivedCategory C) :
    ∃ s : (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj W).CommShift ℤ,
      letI := s
      (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj W).IsTriangulated
